items.claim: A comma-separated `@container` query list matches only through its first query
An inheriting leaf regains the end markers and stroke that `pathAsSvgDraws` removed
An `em` geometry length under a `<use>` is read against the target's DOM ancestors
items.note: (also covers image boxes, nested `<svg>` x/y, `<text>` x/y and the `<use>`'s own x/y)

items.claim: `visibility="hidden"` on a `<use>` or `<text>` drops descendants that turn visibility back on
items.note: (`<use>`) and 0793e7d525 (`<text>`: a hidden text with a visible tspan is kept, and its hidden runs take their place on the line but paint nothing)

items.claim: A `<tspan x>` that stays on its line is dropped, and splits the `x`-list measurement as if it opened a line
items.note: (lines now split where the tspan walk's `LineTracker` splits them; a lone same-line `x` is read as spacing, with a warning where no loaded face can measure it)

items.claim: `opacity` and `clip-path` on a `<use>` are dropped silently
`stop-color: currentColor` is read as black
A chain of `<use>` references never counts toward `NESTING_LIMIT`
A text run with no stroke of its own loses the node's inner or outer stroke on export
`fill-opacity` does not count as an element setting its own fill
A `<use>` that sets its own paint is read as taking its group's paint
`opacity` and `clip-path` on a `<use>` dropped without a warning
items.note: duplicate of A's `<use>` opacity/clip finding, fixed ac3ceb0966

items.claim: A custom painter's `'world'` pattern paint is written in the pose frame without being mapped back
items.note: (the painter command type admits only a `texture` pattern, so the test uses that)

items.claim: `visibility="hidden"` on a `<use>` or `<text>` drops visible descendants
items.note: duplicate of A's visibility finding, fixed 19a8f21ac0 and 0793e7d525

items.claim: `scaleStroke` leaves a stroke with no `width` at 1 while scaling its dashes and heads
A `<g>`'s `marker-*` was never read into the group's stroke . The `<g>` was exported with no marker, so an open path taking the group's stroke lost its arrow on a parse-and-export
A text run whose stroke paints nothing was written with no `stroke` attribute . The kit reads that run as unstroked, but the exported `<tspan>` took the text's stroke
`<use>` and `<symbol>` children skip the container checks
`fitLeafXml` cuts a start tag at a `>` inside an attribute value
`<switch>` passes over a `<use>` child
`stroke-dashoffset` in `em` is read against 16px
A rectangular `<path>` traced from another corner becomes a `rect`
A sized marker's def id can collide with another marker's key
items.note: Derived ids are now written `arrow--s2` and `arrow--tip`, and a key containing `--` gets a hashed id. I checked that a file written with the old `-s`/`-tip` ids reads back the same.

items.claim: `currentColor` fallback after a `url()` paint is painted black
Percentages under a nested `<svg>` sized in percent find no viewport
A media override given as `undefined` replaces the default
`currentColor` fallback after `url(#id)` is read as black
A pattern fill is not taken through its element's baked matrix
items.note: Imported patterns now get `units: 'world'`, as user-space gradients already do. So `svgNodesToKitDrafts` turns them into box-anchored kit paints; before, they had no units and the renderer drew them in screen space.

items.claim: `<switch>` passes over a `<use>` child
A nested `<svg>`'s `opacity` and `transform` are dropped
items.note: The root `<svg>`'s own `opacity` is still dropped without a warning. I did not fix or file that.

items.claim: A framed text node's shadow and edge are refitted onto its box on export
items.note: Under a rotation the shadow and edge are now baked and turned about the box center.

items.claim: A nested `<svg>` without `width`/`height` finds no viewport
items.note: duplicate of A's nested-`<svg>` percentage finding
